strategy.entryPriceSub: limit price for the first order (0 = auto, one step from market)
strategy.entryPriceHint: On start the bot places one limit order here; the grid is spread only after it fills.
strategy.directionLongSub: Buy dips, take profit above entry
strategy.directionShortSub: Sell rallies, take profit below entry
strategy.tpExplain: Exit levels are computed from the entry→liquidation distance, mirrored on the profit side. They move automatically as averaging shifts your entry.
strategy.tpTriggerSub: % from entry, used only when liquidation price is unknown
strategy.closePerLevelSub: % per level; also sets the number of levels (33% → 3)
strategy.tpWidthSub: % of entry→liquidation distance (100% = current, higher = farther)
